item.title: Who Lions must re-sign in free agency — and who they shouldn’t
item.description: With several contributors set to hit free agency, Detroit’s front office must carefully determine which players are worth re-signing and which ones it should allow to depart.

item.title: Former Browns OT, who sat out in 2025 due to injury, visits Detroit Lions
item.description: The Detroit Lions are continuing their due diligence to revamp their offensive line. According to NFL insider Jordan Schultz, former Cleveland Browns offensive tackle Jedrick Wills met with the Lions this week.

item.title: Parchment scores 15, Illinois women win 71-69 over No. 18 Michigan State in Big Ten Tournament
item.description: Cearah Parchment scored 15 points, and Destiny Jackson added 14 for No. 10-seeded Illinois in a 71-69 win over No. 10-seeded Michigan State in the Big Ten Tournament on Thursday night.

item.title: Red Wings reacquire veteran forward David Perron
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings on Thursday reacquired left wing David Perron from the Ottawa Senators for a conditional fourth-round pick in the 2026 draft. Perron, 37, is on injured reserve following sports hernia/groin surgery in January. He was expected to return in mid-March.

item.title: Photos of ATAP vs. Center Line Prep Academy in a D3 boys hoops regional final
item.description: Arts & Tech Academy of Pontiac booked its trip back to the D3 quarterfinals by beating Center Line Prep Academy 103-51 in a regional championship Thursday, March 5, 2026 in Clawson.

item.title: No. 8 Michigan State beats Rutgers 91-87 before closing regular season at No. 3 Michigan
item.description: Jeremy Fears had 21 points and eight assists and Coen Carr also scored 21, helping No. 8 Michigan State hold off Rutgers 91-87 on Thursday night.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan holds off a late run by Iowa, beats the Hawkeyes 71-68
item.description: By JOHN BOHNENKAMP IOWA CITY, Iowa (AP) — Morez Johnson Jr. and Yaxel Lendeborg scored 16 points apiece, and Aday Mara had two tiebreaking shots in the final 1:22 as No. 3 Michigan defeated Iowa 71-68 on Thursday night. item.title: Wembanyama has 38 points and 16 rebounds in the Spurs’ 121-106 win over the Pistons
item.description: Victor Wembanyama had 38 points, 16 rebounds and five blocks and the San Antonio Spurs never trailed in completing a sweep of Detroit, beating the Pistons 121-106 on Thursday night.

item.title: Lewis Lovejoy goes for 42 points, ATAP thumps Center Line Prep 103-51 for regional title
item.description: Arts and Tech Academy of Pontiac guard Lewis Lovejoy didn't seem to be feeling any effects on Thursday of the evidently minor cramping issues he had two nights prior.

item.title: Brother Rice delivers Fitzgerald a taste of its own defensive medicine, wins second regional in three years
item.description: Birmingham Brother Rice clamped down on Warren Fitzgerald to win a Division 1 regional title.
